description: Stage 1 of the cross-venue pair protocol (docs/ARB_TAXONOMY.md, section 4): title pairs and the verdict the automated screen must reach. Both implementations, src/scanner/crossVenueQuestionMatch.ts here and app/cross_pairs.py in the website repo, run every case in their test suites. The verdict vocabulary is neutral so each implementation maps its own labels onto it. A case is added whenever a live run shows a mismatch that got through, with the run as its source.
